mentions.description: A website for prayer and reflection, offering a quiet spot on the internet for spiritual practice. It recently added a feature that returns a Bible reading (King James version only for now) in response to a submitted prayer.
mentions.source_excerpt: A hobby project I started putting together late last year; a little spot on the internet for prayer and reflection. I've just shipped a small feature where you get a Bible reading (KJ only for now) in response to a prayer.
